_comment: Terms chosen or confirmed for the lesson magic-bullet. status: ok = established in a Turkish source I opened; chosen = my own choice, no source uses exactly this; check = weakly attested, needs a Turkish-language reviewer. Sources named here were opened (see content/research-notes/magic-bullet.md).

magic-bullet.note: core.json has ‘şırınga (hipodermik iğne) / sihirli mermi modeli’ (check) and the course title is ‘Şırınga ve Sihirli Mermi Modeli’ (project). Yaylagül 2006 (full PDF read, section ‘Propaganda / Uyarıcı-Tepki / Sihirli Mermi / Hipodermik İğne Modeli’, pp. 45-46) says the model is also known as ‘hipodermik iğne’, ‘sihirli mermi’, ‘uyarıcı-tepki’ or ‘propaganda modeli’ and explains it with a ‘şırınga ya da sihirli mermi’ image. ‘Kurşun’ (silver bullet) appears once in Yaylagül’s OCR text; not used.

powerful-effects.note: Matches the unit title in the course (‘Güçlü Etki Varsayımı ve Propaganda’). Yaylagül 2006 speaks of iletişim araçlarının ‘güçlü bir etkiye sahip olduğu’ anlayışı, not of a fixed term.

limited-effects.note: Course unit ‘Sınırlı Etkiler Dönemi’ (project). Yaylagül 2006 uses ‘Minimum Etki Yaklaşımı’ in a heading (‘Görgül Araştırmalar ve Minimum Etki Yaklaşımı’; OCR imperfect).

powerful-to-limited-story.note: Pooley 2006 abstract: ‘powerful-to-limited-effects story line’. Turkish rendering is mine.

straw-man.note: No established Turkish equivalent was confirmed in a source I opened (candidates seen only from memory: ‘korkuluk safsatası’, ‘saman adam’). The lesson keeps the English term in italics and glosses it as ‘çürütmesi kolay olsun diye çarpıtılmış rakip’.

remembered-history.note: From the title of Pooley 2006 (‘the remembered history of mass communication research’).

retrospective-label.note: My own wording for the historians’ point.

suggestibility.note: ‘Telkin’ is the ordinary Turkish word for suggestion; no Turkish communication source using this exact compound was opened.

critical-ability.note: Cantril writes ‘critical ability’ and, for the older psychological wording, ‘critical faculty’. Turkish rendering is mine.

checking-up.note: Herzog’s concept as described by Pooley & Socolow 2013.

standards-of-judgment.note: Cantril’s term; Turkish rendering is mine.

ubiquity-cumulation-consonance.note: Noelle-Neumann 1973 as summarised by Salmon & Kline 1983. Turkish spiral-of-silence sources may use other words for ‘consonance’ (e.g. ‘uyumluluk’); not verified.

propaganda-analysis.note: Sproule’s term for the interwar critical paradigm; Turkish rendering is mine.
